/bin/zsh -lc "./run_python -c 'from app import rank_documents, RetrievalCache
from copy import deepcopy

# Ranking order, tie break, and deep independence.
docs = [
    {\"id\": \"z\", \"score\": 2, \"payload\": {\"x\": [{\"n\": 1}]}},
    {\"id\": \"a\", \"score\": 2, \"payload\": {\"x\": [{\"n\": 2}]}},
    {\"id\": \"b\", \"score\": -10, \"payload\": {}},
]
before = deepcopy(docs)
r = rank_documents(docs, 2)
assert [d[\"id\"] for d in r] == [\"a\", \"z\"] and docs == before
r[0][\"payload\"][\"x\"][0][\"n\"] = 99
assert docs == before and rank_documents(docs, 2)[0][\"payload\"][\"x\"][0][\"n\"] == 2

# Identity canonicalization, full-result retention, TTL edge, and no-hit extension.
calls = []
source_docs = deepcopy(docs)
def source(t, q, rev):
    calls.append((t, deepcopy(q), rev))
    return source_docs
cache = RetrievalCache(source, ttl=3)
q1 = {\"text\": \"Q\", \"filters\": {\"b\": \"2\", \"a\": \"1\"}}
q2 = {\"filters\": {\"a\": \"1\", \"b\": \"2\"}, \"text\": \"Q\"}
assert cache.search(\"T\", q1, \"R\", 5, limit=1)[0][\"id\"] == \"a\"
assert cache.search(\"T\", q2, \"R\", 7, limit=3) == rank_documents(docs, 3)
assert len(calls) == 1
cache.search(\"T\", q2, \"R\", 8, limit=0)
assert len(calls) == 1
assert cache.search(\"T\", q2, \"R\", 8, limit=1)[0][\"id\"] == \"a\"
assert len(calls) == 2  # expires at acquisition time 5 + ttl 3

# Source query and returned-doc ownership; callers cannot alter cache.
retained = []
def mutating_source(t, q, rev):
    retained.append(q)
    got = [{\"id\": \"x\", \"score\": 1, \"payload\": {\"a\": [1]}}]
    retained.append(got)
    return got
c = RetrievalCache(mutating_source)
caller_q = {\"text\": \"t\", \"filters\": {}}
out = c.search(\"t\", caller_q, \"r\", 0)
retained[0][\"text\"] = \"changed\"
retained[1][0][\"payload\"][\"a\"][0] = 8
out[0][\"payload\"][\"a\"][0] = 9
assert caller_q[\"text\"] == \"t\"
assert c.search(\"t\", caller_q, \"r\", 1)[0][\"payload\"][\"a\"] == [1]

# Errors are retried and do not poison another identity.
attempts = 0
def flaky(t, q, rev):
    global attempts
    attempts += 1
    if q[\"text\"] == \"bad\" and attempts == 1:
        raise LookupError(\"same exception\")
    return [{\"id\": q[\"text\"], \"score\": 0, \"payload\": {}}]
f = RetrievalCache(flaky)
assert f.search(\"t\", {\"text\": \"good\", \"filters\": {}}, \"r\", 0)[0][\"id\"] == \"good\"
try:
    f.search(\"t\", {\"text\": \"bad\", \"filters\": {}}, \"r\", 0)
except LookupError as e:
    assert str(e) == \"same exception\"
else:
    raise AssertionError(\"source error did not propagate\")
assert f.search(\"t\", {\"text\": \"bad\", \"filters\": {}}, \"r\", 0)[0][\"id\"] == \"bad\"
print(\"contract probes passed\")'"
